q: Sheffield United were relegated from the Premier League on the final day of the 2006–07 season. Who was their manager?
hint: He had taken the club up as Championship runners-up the season before, and left within days of the relegation-day defeat at Bramall Lane.

q: Who was Sheffield United's leading scorer in the 2018–19 Championship season, with 23 league goals, as the club won promotion to the Premier League?
hint: The Sheffield-born striker came through the club's own academy; McGoldrick was next on the list that season with 15.

q: Sheffield United were relegated from the Premier League on the final day of 1993–94, losing 3–2 away to which club?
hint: Mark Stein scored twice at Stamford Bridge on 7 May 1994, the second in stoppage time, on a chaotic final afternoon that sent the Blades down in 20th.

q: Sheffield United lost the 1993 FA Cup semi-final 2–1 to Sheffield Wednesday. At which ground was the all-Sheffield tie played?
hint: Chris Waddle's second-minute free-kick and Mark Bright's extra-time header settled it; Alan Cork had equalised for United.

q: In 2002–03 Sheffield United reached both domestic cup semi-finals. Which club knocked them out of the League Cup?
hint: United won the first leg 2–1 at Bramall Lane, but lost 2–0 after extra time at Anfield to go out 3–2 on aggregate — and the winners lifted the trophy.

q: Sheffield United lost the 2003 First Division play-off final 3–0 at the Millennium Stadium. Which club beat them?
hint: Dave Jones's side led 3–0 by half-time in Cardiff through Mark Kennedy, Nathan Blake and Kenny Miller; United had beaten Nottingham Forest 5–4 on aggregate in the semi-final.

q: Sheffield United went up to the Premier League as Championship runners-up in 2005–06. Which club won the title that season with 106 points?
hint: The champions ran away with it on 106 points while the Blades finished second on 90; Watford came up through the play-offs.

q: On the final day of 2006–07 Sheffield United were relegated after losing 2–1 at Bramall Lane. Who were the visitors that afternoon?
hint: Both clubs finished on 38 points and the visitors survived on goal difference; Jon Stead had equalised before a first-half penalty won it.
